limitations: Finite testing cannot establish universal mutual independence.
D2.1 near-neighbour retrieval is probabilistic and non-exhaustive; exact Hamming verification prevents approximate-distance false positives but candidate retrieval can miss neighbours.
D2.1 sensitivity must be reported only for calibrated fault classes and strengths.
Poisson-binomial Hamming inference is model-based and assumes independent mismatch indicators across bit positions.
Pearson p-values and TVD bootstrap intervals are not interchangeable null tests.
Structured collision p-values use stated finite-domain approximations.
Audit replicates are not independent dataset generations.
Calibration evidence is not evidence that the clean dataset is faulty.

methodology.d1_boundary: D1 owns exact duplication and exact partition overlap.
methodology.d2_1: Sampled-query Hamming near-neighbour screen using randomized projection buckets and exact verification; the independent-row Poisson-binomial model supplies a model-based null, while retrieval sensitivity is established empirically rather than assumed exhaustive.
methodology.d2_2: Lagged Hamming structure is tested over declared generation-order lags against an empirical independent-row Poisson-binomial diagnostic null; primary interpretation is serial structure.
methodology.d2_3: Fixed logistic pair detector with held-out test-set label permutation.
methodology.d2_5: Component-specific controlled fault injection; detection estimates include Wilson intervals and distinguish point-estimate from confidence-bound target attainment.
methodology.decision_semantics: Not a proof of universal mutual independence.
methodology.multiple_comparison_control: Bonferroni FWER 0.01 across hypothesis-level parametric comparisons; Monte Carlo replicates are not hypotheses.
methodology.reference_distribution: Binomial(64, 0.5) nominal diagnostic for pairwise Hamming structure under independent balanced bits; confirmatory D2 inference uses an empirical independent-row Poisson-binomial null preserving observed bit marginals
methodology.scope: Dataset Integrity D2 Sample Dependence Audit

audit_configuration.hypothesis_counting: one hypothesis per reported model-based comparison after replicate aggregation; Monte Carlo replicates are not counted as separate hypotheses
audit_configuration.near_duplicate_method: sampled-query random 16-bit projection buckets with exact Hamming verification; probabilistic candidate retrieval, not exhaustive; sensitivity must be calibrated
audit_configuration.reference_distribution: Binomial(64, 0.5) nominal diagnostic for pairwise Hamming structure under independent balanced bits; confirmatory D2 inference uses an empirical independent-row Poisson-binomial null preserving observed bit marginals
audit_configuration.replication_semantics: sampling replicates conditional on one fixed dataset instance
